Never switch off before the final whistle.
An own goal turned into redemption, a last-gasp winner in the 95th minute, and comebacks that changed everything! The opening Gameweeks of MG ISL 2026-27 delivered unbelievable drama.
From Menno Koch's redemption and Borja Martínez's brace as Bengaluru FC defeated Sporting Club Delhi 3-2, to Konsam Sanathoi Meetei's 90+5' winner after Raphael Messi Bouli and Alfred Planas helped Punjab FC fight back against Churchill Brothers SC.
